responsibilities.Order: Own the order lifecycle, snapshots and accepted replacement totals.
responsibilities.Payment: Hold captured amount C and refund obligations without claiming payout.
responsibilities.Quote: Compute and bind the complete consented price; not persisted.
responsibilities.Hub: Represent a kitchen location, capacity and fee.
responsibilities.HubMenuItem: Represent one hub listing and its independent availability.
responsibilities.ReplacementOffer: Hold one proposed whole-line replacement and its decision history.
responsibilities.Customer: Represent customer identity and permitted online payment choices.
responsibilities.ReportController: Authorize Manager requests and construct operational reports without writes.
responsibilities.order: Translate authenticated customer routes and render quote, receipt and order results.
responsibilities.admin: Translate administrator maintenance routes; never provide business decisions.
responsibilities.delivery: Translate shipper requests and render contact and cash information.
responsibilities.kitchen: Translate own-hub kitchen actions and render their results.
responsibilities.reports: Translate Manager filters and render read-only report results.
responsibilities.UserAccount: Hold account identity, role, active flag and optional kitchen-hub assignment.
responsibilities.Address: Hold an owned delivery location and archive flag.
responsibilities.Brand: Group menu items and retain the archived brand identity.
responsibilities.MenuItem: Hold current catalogue text, whole-VND price and archive flag.
responsibilities.Voucher: Check date/subtotal eligibility and calculate the bounded discount.
responsibilities.OrderLine: Retain item/name/price/quantity snapshots and derive the line total.
responsibilities.Delivery: Hold assignment, paired lifecycle times, cash and failure outcome.
responsibilities.LocalCustomer: Specialize the Customer type and permitted payment options for a local customer.
responsibilities.TouristCustomer: Specialize Customer identity and permitted payment options for a tourist.
responsibilities.HubStatus: Derive busy, quiet and load percentage from current load and capacity.
responsibilities.Authorisation: Carry the local simulator decision, reference and message; not persisted.
